entities.name: Timer T3493
entities.description: Timer used in the Remote UE Report procedure. On expiry, triggers retransmission of REMOTE UE REPORT message or procedure abortion after third expiry.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT
entities.description: Message sent by UE in Remote UE Report procedure. Retransmitted on first and second T3493 expiry.

entities.name: Remote UE Report procedure
entities.description: Procedure for reporting remote UE information. Can be aborted on third T3493 expiry and restarted by UE implementation.

entities.name: First expiry of T3493
entities.description: Condition when timer T3493 expires for the first time. UE resends REMOTE UE REPORT and resets/restarts T3493.

entities.name: Third expiry of T3493
entities.description: Condition when timer T3493 expires for the third time. UE aborts Remote UE Report procedure and releases resources.

entities.name: Release procedure resources
entities.description: Behavior where UE releases any resources allocated for the Remote UE Report procedure after abortion.

relations.description: First expiry of T3493 triggers resending of REMOTE UE REPORT message.
First expiry of T3493 causes UE to reset and restart timer T3493.
Third expiry of T3493 triggers abortion of Remote UE Report procedure.
Third expiry of T3493 establishes release of procedure resources.
Remote UE Report procedure includes sending REMOTE UE REPORT message.
